silverCityPackIndex.howToEdit: Load one areaPack XML per area. Every lesson has three tiers: <easy easyOrder="N">, <medium>, and <hard> — each with Learn/Match/Hold. Held claim stays plain on all tiers. Hold level-up / fail→Easy: see <holdRules>. Do not fork facts into separate files. Engine loader climb next.

holdRules.summary: On Hold, the player may attempt a level-up to the next tier’s claim/why. If they fail the level-up — or fail Hold at the current tier — fall back to Easy (retry Easy Learn→Match→Hold: teach-before-test, not punish).
holdRules.levelUp: easy Hold may set levelUpTo="medium"; medium Hold may set levelUpTo="hard". Hard is the top teach tier (no further levelUpTo).
holdRules.onFail: Every Hold sets onFail="easy". Failed Hold or failed level-up returns the player to the Easy teach path for that same lesson id.
holdRules.whyBlast: Easy Hold why-step is a 4-chip why-blast (claim center, four why faces). Packs should ship ≥3 unique whyMisses. Wrong tap is Miss −25 (floor 0) and that chip pops out. Correct lock-in is LOCKED! plus a short why-this-is-true takeaway.
holdRules.heldClaim: Claim · reason · source stay the same clear/plain line across easy, medium, and hard. Do not mysterious-ize the held line on Hard.

scoring.notes: Points awarded when the idea is held at that tier. Level-up Hold awards the higher tier’s points (replace or add — prefer: journal records best tier held for that idea; score for an idea = points of highest tier successfully held). On fail→Easy, award Easy only if Easy Hold succeeds.

tool.easy: Love — when compassion moves you, help like the Samaritan. Tap the glowing face.
tool.hard: Love — tap the matching face. A true line turns a cheap claim toward heaven.
tool.note: Mechanic how-to, not a held claim lesson.
tool.claimFacingHard: Love — tap the matching face. A true line turns a cheap claim toward heaven.
tool.reason: Love, logic, reason, and science you have kept can divert a false step up the ridge.
tool.plainTeach: Tap the glowing face. When compassion moves you, help like the Samaritan.

note.claim: A morning walked is kept — not as a trophy, as a thank-you.
note.reason: If you are away, the trail waits; nothing already gathered is taken back.
note.title: First frost on the rail
note.p: You walked a morning that will not come again. The town keeps a small mark for that — not a trophy, a thank-you.
The trail will be here tomorrow. If you are away, it waits. Nothing you have already gathered is taken back.

note.claim: Two mornings are enough for the path to know your step.
note.reason: Nothing is owed; the bench is still free.
note.title: A second lantern
note.p: Two distinct mornings. The path is starting to know your step. Nothing is owed; the bench is still free.

note.claim: Return is a kind of courage.
note.reason: Three distinct days are marked without scolding the ones you missed.
note.title: Margin note from the clerk
note.p: Three distinct days on the trail. The archive clerk left this: “Return is a kind of courage.”

note.claim: Five skies are saved; empty days are not scolded.
note.reason: The town only keeps a page for when you are here.
note.title: Five weather reports
note.p: Five different skies. The town does not scold the days you were away. It only saves a page for when you are here.

note.claim: Seven unique mornings still leave tomorrow free.
note.reason: If you miss, the trail waits; marks you made stay in the journal.
note.title: A week of porches
note.p: Seven unique mornings. If you miss tomorrow, the trail waits. The marks you already made stay in the journal.
